2. Daily Summary
Young & Sons Drywall (YSD) crews worked at the Kelsey-Seybold Lake Jackson Renovation for Gamma Construction (PO #4122) under Foreman Fredy Davila. A walk-around of the exterior of the building was documented, including two emergency exits. Material was neatly stacked and kept away from work areas, with enough space to walk and pass through. Metal framing is kept outside, out of everyone's way; workers come outside, get what they need, and take it inside, which reduces the amount of material and trash inside the building. Job progress was documented inside the building, including laborers laying down track and working on framing at ground level, and the area where the finishers keep all of their materials for prepping. Personal tools were in good shape, with zero defects found. Workers used PPE at all times, and workers operating lifts used fall protection at all times. A YSD scaffold was properly built, workers had personal fans to keep themselves cool, and temporary power was provided. QR codes for the YSD Safety Manual and SDS booklets are provided at the gang box, and first aid kits are kept inside the gang box in case of an emergency. Workers throw all of their trash in the dumpster to keep the site clean.
